# Cognarah

> Cognarah is an AI-focused media publication covering artificial intelligence news, startups, funding, tools, policy, and analysis, with a dedicated spotlight on Africa AI.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Latest AI news, features, and the Africa AI spotlight.
- [About](/about): What Cognarah covers and who it's for.
- [Search](/search): Search articles across every category.

## Categories

- [News](/category/news): Breaking AI news and industry updates.
- [Africa AI](/category/africa-ai): AI developments, builders, and policy across Africa.
- [Startups](/category/startups): AI startup launches and product news.
- [Funding](/category/funding): AI funding rounds and investor moves.
- [Tools](/category/tools): New AI tools, models, and platforms.
- [Trends](/category/trends): Emerging trends and market shifts in AI.
- [Analysis](/category/analysis): In-depth analysis of AI stories.
- [Opinions](/category/opinions): Commentary on AI's impact.
- [Interviews](/category/interviews): Conversations with AI leaders and builders.
- [Policy & Ethics](/category/policy-ethics): AI regulation, governance, and ethics.
- [Events](/category/events): AI conferences, summits, and gatherings.
